events.title: Certiorari Denied in Wainwright v. Florida
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States denied the application for a stay of execution and the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of Anthony F. Wainwright v. Florida. The application was initially presented to Justice Thomas, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the execution of the death sentence will proceed as scheduled, and the Court will not review the case.
events.why_relevant: The denial of certiorari and stay of execution affects the administration of justice and the finality of capital punishment cases.

events.title: Supreme Court vacates stay in Highland Capital Management v. NexPoint Advisors
events.summary: The Supreme Court, through Justice Samuel A. Alito, vacated a previously issued stay in the case of Highland Capital Management, L.P. v. NexPoint Advisors, L.P., et al. The application for a stay, which had been issued on May 29, 2025, was denied in all respects. This procedural action effectively allows the lower court's decision to proceed without further delay from the Supreme Court.
